verdict.rationale: Gecko's docs describe cross-file, compiler-accurate source code analysis across 8 languages. Each finding comes with a source-to-sink call chain, CVSS severity and a proof of concept, which is consistent with taint-style detection of injection-type flaws. Hands-on community reports, however, describe 100%-confidence findings that were not real and scans that returned zero findings, which undercuts detection reliability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the vulnerability classes covered (injection, XSS) or the rule set, and independent corroboration of accurate detection.
